ns2:section.sectionText: Students will utilize a combination of online lessons and discussion sections and office hours, and required e-book access. Two proctored hourly exams and a proctored final exam will be administered either on campus or online through the online proctoring service, ProctorU. Taking exams via the online option requires access to a stable internet connection and a webcam. Students will need to attend one of three weekly online discussion sessions.
